categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches only socket logic in src/net.cpp and functional tests; does not modify the build system, toolchains, CI, or platform build configuration.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies listener socket options in src/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents local processes on Windows from hijacking or intercepting incoming P2P connections. Under Windows SO_REUSEADDR semantics, another process running under the same user could otherwise bind the same port without an error.
